name: Avvoka
description: Avvoka is a document automation platform for legal teams. The connector lets you generate documents from your Avvoka templates and template packs, drafting a single document or a multi-document bundle in one step. You can find, review, and update existing documents, export them, and browse your clause library.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Avvoka to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Avvoka to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.avvoka.us/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Avvoka MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avvoka provides these MCP tools: avvoka_find_templates, avvoka_get_template, avvoka_get_template_pack, avvoka_create_document, avvoka_create_document_pack, avvoka_find_documents, avvoka_get_document, avvoka_get_document_pack, avvoka_update_document_fields, avvoka_export_document, avvoka_find_and_pick_clause, and avvoka_export_clause_variant.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Avvoka?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Avvoka in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Avvoka requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Avvoka is developed by Avvoka. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
